Name: Tayo the Little Bus
Author: WisnuNug
Description:
[left][size=3]﻿[/size][/left]This mod changes the bus with various colors from the Korean children's animated series [color=#6fa8dc]Tayo[/color], like in the film the buses have various colors from red blue yellow green, and they have their own names!.

Config:

[list]
[*] Tayo Model from Generic mods config menu : "[color=#ff0000] [/color][color=#ff0000]Gani, Lani, Rogi, Tayo, Trammy, Peanut[/color]" each name has a color that indicates its true color.
[*]Seasonal Leaves can be activated in the config menu, by default it is "disabled" you can make it enabled to activate it,
[/list]
I've tried to draw as best I can if there is a discrepancy in the color please let me know.-_-

Manifest.Name: Tayo the Little Bus
Manifest.Description: A CP Tayo Little Bus with seasonal simple leaves.
